topics.quote: maia made a motion to accept the minutes of november 20, 2025, as presented, seconded by stephanie. the motion passed with five votes, with robin abstaining.

muir is on parental leave for six to eight weeks. in his absence, lydia paolilli is the acting director. the teen librarian search has been put on hold during muir's absence, since lydia does not have authority to fill in for the hiring decision process. minna scholten has been hired to fill the library assistant position in the children's room.
the 2nd annual winter artisan showcase was held on sunday, december 7, with over 40 vendors attending. the vendors were pleased with the success of the event.
melanie will be having another petting zoo for the library of things to be held at smokestack roasters in january. melanie is also planning a follow-up event at tritown in february.
we have switched over to a fiber line, as cwmars has suggested for libraries.

the rivard family donated $2,500 to the friends to be used in the children's room. an employer match increased the donation to $5,000 total. ○ an anonymous donor gave $35,000 to the friends to be used for informational resources and to enhance stem information and activitie
